Randle El currently serves as the wide receivers coach and assistant head coach for the Chicago Bears.

🇵🇸 🇷🇸 Serbia's student movement, which won an outright parliamentary majority last month and ended Aleksandar Vučić's 12-year grip on power, plans to stop the country's arms trade with Israel, Student List representative Filip Ubović told Novara Media's Aaron Bastani. 

He also called "very outrageous" the drone factory Vučić opened in September with Israeli weapons maker Elbit Systems near Belgrade, saying it "must be stopped." Elbit owns 51% of the plant, a joint venture with Serbia's state arms firm Jugoimport SDPR, and part of an Israel-Serbia military deal worth more than $1.6 billion. Serbia exported €114 million in arms and military equipment to Israel from 2023 to 2025, according to Serbian business outlet eKapija.

The leaderless Student List won 52.5% of the vote in the Oct. 25 election and is now forming a government.

🎥 via @novaramedia

And America's military options are becoming increasingly limited.

Iran is under pressure, but the blockade has serious gaps.

Brandon even argues Vance should consider sitting out the 2028 presidential race.

But his central assessment is that Trump may already be looking for a way to avoid another major war.

The problem? He can keep threatening Iran, but settling for a blockade that neither forces regime change nor delivers a decisive victory would be a difficult outcome to sell back home.

🌍 WHERE ARE THE PEOPLE WITH MERCY? WHERE ARE THE HUMAN HEARTS? PLEASE, HEAR A MOTHER'S CRY!

My name is Eman. I am a mother in Gaza, fighting every day to protect my seven children from hunger, illness, and the freezing winter.

I have four beautiful quadruplets — Yasser, Tia, Lia, and Mohammed — and three older children: Maryam, Tulin, and Iyad.

Seven children. Seven little hearts depending on me. And I am struggling to provide even their most basic needs.

💔 I HAVE ALREADY LOST ONE OF MY CHILDREN. I KNOW THE PAIN OF LOSING A CHILD, AND I CANNOT BEAR TO WATCH MY OTHER CHILDREN SUFFER WITHOUT HELP.

My son Iyad is sick and urgently needs medical examinations and treatment. My other children are also suffering from health problems and the terrible conditions surrounding us.

😭 WINTER IS HERE, AND OUR TENT IS NOT PROTECTING MY CHILDREN!

Rain, freezing cold, and insects are making our lives unbearable. Every night, I worry about my children sleeping in these conditions.

Every morning, I have to light a fire just to heat water for my little quadruplets and prepare food for my family. Is this how seven children should have to live?

🚨 WE URGENTLY NEED $600 TO PROTECT MY CHILDREN THIS WINTER.

Our desperate needs are:

🏕️ A safe tent to protect my children from rain and cold.

🥛 Food, milk, diapers, and clean water.

🧥 Warm winter clothes for my children.

💊 Medicines and urgent medical examinations for Iyad and my other children.

🔥 Cooking gas so I can prepare food and heat water safely.

💔 PLEASE, STOP FOR A MOMENT AND IMAGINE MY LIFE.

What does a mother do when seven children look into her eyes, waiting for food, warmth, and protection, and she has nothing left to give them?

My previous appeal reached around 700,000 views. So many people saw our suffering, but my children are still waiting for real help.

PLEASE, DON'T LET OUR STORY BECOME JUST ANOTHER POST THAT PEOPLE READ AND FORGET.

🙏 If 600 people donate just $1, we can reach our $600 goal. If you cannot donate, please repost and quote-post. Your share might reach the person who can save us from this suffering.

TO EVERY SISTER, EVERY BROTHER, EVERY MOTHER, EVERY FATHER, AND EVERY KIND HEART AROUND THE WORLD:

I am Eman, a mother in Gaza. I am exhausted, frightened, and struggling, but I will never stop fighting for my seven children.

😭 MY CHILDREN ARE NOT ASKING FOR LUXURY. THEY ARE ASKING FOR A WARM PLACE TO SLEEP, FOOD TO EAT, MILK TO DRINK, AND MEDICINE WHEN THEY ARE SICK.

💔 PLEASE, TURN YOUR COMPASSION INTO ACTION. DON'T JUST WATCH OUR SUFFERING. HELP US!
